title: 地方菜正在出圈①徐州伏羊：最热的三伏天，为什么喝最烫的羊汤 | Rising Flavors P1 · Xuzhou 🐑
description:
三伏天，你敢喝一碗滚烫羊汤吗？评论区说说你那儿三伏天吃什么。

【这个夏天·地方菜正在出圈 第1集 徐州伏羊】一年里最热的三伏天，徐州人偏偏排队去喝一碗滚烫的羊汤。越热越吃羊、出一身透汗——老徐州把这叫"以热制热"：在伏天发汗，把一身暑气逼出去，是"冬病夏治"的老讲究。乳白的羊汤，撒上香菜和一勺红辣油。这口"伏羊食俗"2021年就被列为国家级非物质文化遗产；徐州的始祖彭祖，被尊为中华烹饪始祖，还创出"羊方藏鱼"这道天下第一菜。自2004年起徐州年年办彭祖伏羊节，一碗伏羊汤，点亮了整座城的夏天。所以——最热的天，喝最烫的汤。

Ep.1 Xuzhou. On the hottest days of the year, this city queues for boiling mutton soup. The hotter it gets, the more mutton they eat and the harder they sweat — locals call it "heat fights heat": sweating through the dog days to drive out summer's heat. A milky broth, coriander, a spoon of chili oil. Xuzhou's "Fuyang" mutton custom became national intangible cultural heritage in 2021, and its forefather Pengzu is revered as the ancestor of Chinese cooking. One bowl carries thousands of years — so on the hottest day, you drink the hottest soup.

AI-assisted edit; the bilingual subtitles are the narration — no voiceover. Facts checked this run; sources below. Food & folk-custom note, not medical or health advice. Footage licensed from Pexels (credited below).
